description: Create a new construction estimate project in the connected Portravo account from a project name, an explicit trades selection returned by preflight_takeoff, an optional address and an optional supported metro_code. Trades are required for customer projects; only the isolated synthetic reviewer may omit them. Repeating a call with the same idempotency_key returns the original project instead of creating another. Returns reviewUrl, the project page where the user can also upload a plan PDF in the browser. Does not run extraction or consume estimate credits.
name: create_project
title: Create a takeoff project
